arts appreciation and cultural understanding among the nus community and external communities. apply now nus performing and visual arts scholarship (mid-term) the nus performing & visual arts scholarship is awarded to highly-talented individuals who possess outstanding academic, performing and/or visual arts participation and representation records. apply now cac creator grant the cac creators’ grant is an initiative by the nus cultural activities club (cac) designed to support full-time nus undergraduates in executing self-led arts or cultural projects. apply now nussu space e-newsletter artwork requirements: image must be exactly 600 × 400 pixels (px) . for queries, email osay@nus.edu.sg . nus arts & cfa channels nus arts on campus telegram group: send request to admins to publicise arts events on campus or open calls for participants. the channel is monitored by nus. nus cfa instagram: tag @nuscfa on instagram for relevant arts promotions. nus cfa holds discretion for content shared. 2 weeks before promotion setting up official portal events (nusync) if you want to invite all students to join your student-body-led activities (on or off campus), you should host them on: nusync event creation guide important: after saving, your group may need to submit additional information to campus administrators and await final approval before the event goes live. for technical help, view the: physical campus media workflow email university campus infrastructure contactuci@nus.edu.sg to inform them of activity and intended physical banners to be put up around specified locations on nus. write directly to the specific venue owners to inquire about availability, and make sure to include all of your organization's contact details in the email. click here to book spaces to put up physical banners: book spaces banner venue listings reach us info.nuscac@gmail.com where we are nus students' cultural activities club yusof ishak house 31 lower kent ridge road nus cultural activities club about us discover nus arts on campus © 2026 national university of singapore, last updated 24 september 2026

title: About | NUS Cultural Activities Club (CAC)
content: this website is under development. check in again on 4 october 2026. about venue funding publicity resources student groups equipment loaning production guide about venue funding publicity resources student groups equipment loaning production guide nus students’ cultural activities club (cac) is a non-faculty club under nussu, with a focus on bridging the arts in school among students of varying interests and expertise. we aim to be the voice of student artists on campus, advocating for their best interests and promoting collaboration between different arts groups and forms. about us nus cfa supernova 2026 overdrive affiliated websites: supernova supernova: rising star is a competition spotlighting student talent, ranging from live music and dance moves, to tasty carnival food and drinks. situated at utown green, nus student life shines brightest at this annual outdoor music and dance festival open for all to participate in! find out more overdrive overdrive is a day-to-night arts carnival that celebrates the diversity of art forms on campus. located at the central library forum, overdrive offers a unique experience from vibrant music, to dance performances, and visual arts. overdrive is a free event where the boundaries between audience and artist disappear, open to anyone and everyone to enjoy! find out more workshops cac workshops provide an opportunity for students to share their artistic skills and craft with others on campus. it is also an opportunity for students to participate in arts workshops for free! find out more creator grants for students, by students, the cac creator's grant is a grant for any primarily nus undergraduate arts-related groups who require funding, publicity and space support for any arts or cultural projects they have in mind. the grant funds 100% of the proposed budget or $1000, whichever lower. apply here reach us info.nuscac@gmail.com where we are nus students' cultural activities club yusof ishak house 31 lower kent ridge road nus cultural activities club about us discover nus arts on campus © 2026 national university of singapore, last updated 24 september 2026 management committee culture arts heritage vision mission history executive committee history team members
